name: engine-blender
description: Blender for Studio: the blender tool (bpy scripts headless; detect; describe a .blend as data; import and export glb, gltf, fbx, obj, stl, usd with each engine's axes; quick captures; look-dev renders with Cycles, EEVEE or Workbench and turntables; 3D models to 2D sprite sheets for 2.5D games, in Studio's asset layout; the Harness Bridge add-on for the person's open Blender), the blender-file gate, the blender-artist agent and the blender-scripting and blender-sprites skills. Blender runs where the session's commands run.
